folder: What Happens When You Ignore Her Teeth - Glass Cat

shots.vo_line: This is what would happen to a cat whose owner ignores her teeth.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat takes two slow, heavy steps forward across the rug, head low, mouth slightly open, light refracting gently through her glass body and the red glow in her gums pulsing faintly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: After the first month, plaque starts creeping under
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, subtle motion: the open mouth trembles slightly, the plaque film glistens and the red-orange glow in the gums pulses faintly, gentle light refractions sliding across the glass. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: the gumline, where it should never be.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly licks her lips once and lets her tongue settle back, ears twitching uneasily, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: She gets the dental biscuits. They crumble before they do anything.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat chews slowly on the biscuit, a few dry crumbs falling softly to the floor around her paws, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: She gets the water additive. It smells wrong to a nose 40 times more sensitive than yours.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly sniffs towards the water bowl, then pulls her head back with a wrinkled nose, her body staying in place, light refracting gently through her glass body. The bowl and bottle stay still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: So she goes back to chewing the charger cable.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gnaws the white cable with small slow jaw movements, the cable trembling slightly, light refracting gently through her glass body. She stays crouched in place. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's the only thing that soothes her gums.
shots.motion_prompt: Close-up: the cat slowly gnaws the cable with her side teeth, eyes half closed in relief, jaw moving gently, light refracting gently through her glass body. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Her owner moves the water bowl closer. She sniffs it once and walks away.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman gently slides the bowl a little towards the cat; the cat sniffs once and slowly turns her head away, staying in frame, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After two months, her breath starts catching you when she yawns,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat finishes a slow wide yawn, the red glow in her gums visible; the woman flinches back slightly, eyes squeezed shut, nose wrinkling. Light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: on the pillow when she sleeps.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sleeps on, breathing slowly, her glass body glinting softly in the lamplight; the woman slowly turns her face further away, nose wrinkling. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner notices, but tells herself that's just how cats are.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman gives a small shrug and a half-smile, hands settling back onto her lap; the cat sits calmly beside her, blinking slowly, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The chewing gets worse.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat chews hard on the frayed cable with slow, firm jaw movements, the cable trembling, light refracting gently through her glass body. She stays crouched in place. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner buys another charger. Nothing changes.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman lets out a slow sigh, shoulders dropping as she looks at the new charger in her hands; the glass cat on the sofa watches her, blinking slowly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After three months, the plaque has hardened into tartar.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, subtle motion: the open jaw trembles slightly, the crusted tartar and wet tongue glisten and the red glow in the gums pulses faintly, gentle light refractions across the glass. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every single bite pushes it into gums that were never meant to take it.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat chews slowly with eyes squeezed shut, wincing with each bite, her head staying over the bowl, light refracting gently through her glass body. The bowl stays still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The discomfort never fully stops.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits hunched and still, breathing slowly, ears drooping a little lower, eyes half closed, light refracting gently through her glass body. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: She starts pulling her head away every time her owner tries to touch her face.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat pulls her head back a little further and flattens her ears as the woman's hand pauses mid-reach, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner calls it attitude. It's not attitude.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds her hiss, ears back, body trembling slightly; the woman stays kneeling and leans back a little, hands raised in surprise, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's pain. And she's dealing with it alone, every single day.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat lies still with her chin on her paws, breathing slowly, eyes blinking heavily, light refracting gently through her glass body and dust motes drifting in the sunlight. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: By month four, she's started pawing and rubbing at her own mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat paws slowly at her mouth with one front paw, face screwed up, her body staying seated in place, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Her owner thinks it's grooming. It's not grooming.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat licks her paw and slowly rubs it over her mouth; behind her the woman turns a page of her book, unconcerned. Light refracts gently through the glass. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: It's her body desperately trying to fix what nothing in that home is fixing for her.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly rubs her cheek against the corner of the table leg, eyes shut tight, her body staying in place, light refracting gently through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: This doesn't have to happen.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits calmly in the sunbeam, gazing up hopefully and blinking slowly, whiskers twitching, light refracting gently through her glass body and dust motes floating in the light. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Her saliva already reaches every tooth,
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, subtle motion: a glistening wave of clear saliva flows gently over every tooth, sparkling as it moves, the jaw trembling slightly, light refracting through the glass. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: every gap and every gumline, all day and all night.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, subtle motion: glistening saliva seeps gently into every gap between the teeth and along the gumline, catching the light, gentle refractions through the glass. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: No brush has ever done that.
shots.motion_prompt: In the background the cat walks slowly further into the room, tail up, staying in frame; the toothbrush in the foreground stays completely still. Sunlight glints through her glass body. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The moment Meow Mouth goes on her dinner, she eats it,
shots.motion_prompt: The hand slowly tips the scoop and powder sprinkles gently onto the food; the cat leans in slightly, nose twitching. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and her own saliva carries the zinc and plant enzymes to the plaque.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow, subtle motion: glistening saliva washes over the teeth as tiny plaque flakes lift off and drift away, the red glow in the gums slowly fading to soft pink. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every single meal does what it's supposed to do.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats happily from the bowl with slow, contented chewing, eyes half closed, light refracting gently through her glass body. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And because it's made with brewer's yeast and a bacon flavour,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sniffs the food slowly, nose twitching, eyes half closed in bliss, her head staying above the bowl, light refracting gently through her glass body. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: she clears her bowl every time she comes back.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly licks the empty bowl clean, tail curled up and swaying gently, light refracting gently through her glass body. The bowl stays in place. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a week, her breath is softer.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat finishes a gentle yawn and closes her mouth; the woman keeps smiling warmly and stays close, not pulling away. Light refracts softly through the glass cat. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a month, she lets her owner kiss her goodnight again.
shots.motion_prompt: The woman holds a gentle kiss on top of the cat's head, then eases back slightly, smiling; the cat stays curled up, eyes closed, breathing slowly as lamplight glints through the glass. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: That's why she keeps coming back to her bowl every single day,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat takes two slow steps to the bowl, tail held high, and stops, light refracting gently through her glass body. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: cleaning her teeth with every meal, with no brush and no fight.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds a big contented smile, blinking slowly, whiskers twitching, clean white teeth glinting as light refracts gently through her glass body. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's Meow Mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits beside the tub licking her lips contentedly, eyes closed, light refracting gently through her glass body. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: And right now, it's buy two,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sits calmly beside the tubs, smiling and blinking slowly, whiskers twitching, light refracting gently through her glass body. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera, lids closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: get one free.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays curled up asleep, breathing slowly and evenly, an ear twitching once, light refracting gently through her glass body. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.
